# Namespaces

The commands `mt help` lists under Namespaces. More in [Namespaces](../../../concepts/index.md#namespaces).

In a terminal, type `mt` and then the command. In the interactive shell and the cloud shell, type the command on
its own. `mt help <command>` shows the same details in your terminal.

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`namespace-create`](#namespace-create) | Create a namespace |
| [`namespace-delete`](#namespace-delete) | Delete an empty namespace (refused, listing what is left, while it holds anything) |
| [`namespace-get`](#namespace-get) | Show a namespace by name: its id and when it was created |
| [`namespace-list`](#namespace-list) | List the namespaces in the tenant |
| [`namespace-update`](#namespace-update) | Rename a namespace |
| [`ns-get`](#ns-get) | Show the default namespace commands use (MAITENTO_NAMESPACE overrides the saved one) |
| [`ns-set`](#ns-set) | Save the default namespace commands use when given no `--namespace` (MAITENTO_NAMESPACE, when set, overrides it) |

## namespace-create

Create a namespace.

```text
mt namespace-create <name>
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<name>` | text | yes |  | The namespace's name, unique in the tenant |

## namespace-delete

Delete an empty namespace (refused, listing what is left, while it holds anything).

```text
mt namespace-delete <name> [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<name>` | text | yes |  | Name of the namespace to delete |

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--confirm` | flag |  |  | Delete it; without this the command only shows what would be deleted |

## namespace-get

Show a namespace by name: its id and when it was created.

```text
mt namespace-get <name>
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<name>` | text | yes |  | Name of the namespace to show |

## namespace-list

List the namespaces in the tenant.

```text
mt namespace-list
```

## namespace-update

Rename a namespace.

```text
mt namespace-update <name> [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<name>` | text | yes |  | The namespace's current name |

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--new-name <value>` | text | yes |  | Its new name |

## ns-get

Show the default namespace commands use (MAITENTO_NAMESPACE overrides the saved one).

```text
mt ns-get
```

Doesn't need you to sign in.

## ns-set

Save the default namespace commands use when given no `--namespace` (MAITENTO_NAMESPACE, when set, overrides it).

```text
mt ns-set <namespace>
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<namespace>` | text | yes |  | Name of the namespace (it is not checked that it exists) |

Doesn't need you to sign in.
